patient.consentPolicy: Consent to movement summaries is separate from camera permission. Withdrawal stops new collection; earlier records remain until a reviewed deletion request is completed.
patient.consentConfirm: New sessions stop being saved until you agree again on your phone. Earlier records remain until a reviewed deletion request is completed.
patient.requestHelp: Requests are recorded for administrator review. A deletion request does not silently delete data or backups. Development records have no automatic purge; retention must be configured before deployment.
